title: Google Research ScaNN: Three-Phase Vector Search, Anisotropic Quantization & SOAR Overretrieval
author: ontology-spider-learning-wave

edges.description: Dependency hub scann imported by eli5_retrieval_large_lm in Ontology-Spider cross-project DAG (arXiv:1908.10396, arXiv:2404.00774)
Informs Brain Harness dense retrieval indexing, quantization, and rescoring thresholds

claims.assertion: ScaNN organizes scalable nearest-neighbor retrieval into three stages—tree partitioning (num_leaves ~ sqrt(n)), asymmetric hashing or quantized brute-force scoring (dimensions_per_block=2 with anisotropic quantization threshold), and exact top-k' rescoring.

ScannBuilder enforces valid dot-product constraints for AVQ/SOAR, supports MRL vector truncation, configures lut16/lut256 global top-N with residual quantization, and maps anisotropic_quantization_threshold to noise_shaping_threshold in C++ searcher configs.

distilled_learning: Structure scalable dense retrieval around Partition (sqrt(n) leaves + SOAR spillover) -> Anisotropic Asymmetric Hashing (LUT16 residual blocks prioritizing parallel inner-product error) -> Exact Rescoring (top k' > k) instead of unpruned flat brute force.
